stories.headline: Drake skips the Grammys
stories.verification: Rolling Stone reports the Billboard-sourced non-submission of Iceman, Habibti and Maid of Honour; the report also notes Drake's prior Grammy stance and the chart context.

stories.headline: Hottieween returns
stories.verification: Complex reports Megan's Oct. 30 Hottieween announcement and Cirque du Soleil partnership; Zouk's official event page confirms date, venue, ticketing and the Pete & Thomas Foundation benefit.

stories.headline: Young Thug passes the mic
stories.verification: YouTube Theater's announcement identifies the first headlining run since 2019, NAV support and the YSL roster; Live Nation independently lists the U.S. and European tour dates.

stories.headline: OG 3Three stays free
stories.verification: Complex reports Judge Drew B. Tipton denied the federal request to revoke the $200,000 bond on Oct. 5; 24Hip-Hop documents the earlier bond challenge and the allegations as contested pretrial claims.

stories.headline: GTA VI chooses fun
stories.verification: GamesRadar and PC Gamer both report the new Love magazine interview in which Rockstar North co-head Rob Nelson explains the balance between realism, immersion and player convenience.
